Information Credibility Check

Evaluate the reliability of the following information sources. Assign a rank from 1 (Most Credible) to 5 (Least Credible).

live_tv

Media Report

Information reported by news outlets, including press briefings, eyewitness accounts, and early commentary.

account_balance

Official Government Statement

Formal statements released by government agencies or port authorities regarding the incident and ongoing response.

engineering

Engineering Assessment Report

Preliminary technical evaluations conducted by engineers regarding structural safety, system integrity, and operational risk.

eco

Environmental Impact Assessment

Early assessments or estimates regarding potential environmental damage, pollution risks, and ecological consequences.

business

Industry / Company Internal Briefing

Internal updates or briefings prepared by the shipping company or industry experts based on available operational data.
